acceptance: Accept a mathematically certified evolution approximation on the actual finite graph. A finite-time bound need not be uniform in time. Declare any remaining time/ground/continuum limitation explicitly.

definitions.approximation: Define H_tilde_lambda=[[A_lambda,B_lambda*],[B_lambda,C0]] on the full electric block domain, and T_tilde(t)=J*exp(-t H_tilde_lambda/hbar)J. This candidate formulation is shared from independent root/reverse planning; its definition is not a claimed result. Prove self-adjointness, required lower bounds and exact relation to the leading full-H3 memory K2(s)=B*exp(-s C0/hbar)B.
definitions.blocks: H_lambda=H_E+alpha lambda Vmag=[[A_lambda,B_lambda*],[B_lambda,C_lambda]], P=JJ*, Q=1-P; A_lambda=H_eff+alpha lambda(20-b), -1<=b<=1; B_lambda=alpha lambda B1; C_lambda=C0+alpha lambda QVmag Q. Retain all actual Q2 domains.
definitions.comparison: Compare T(t)=J*exp(-tH_lambda/hbar)J and T_tilde on all H3 in operator norm. Establish wellposed strong-integral Volterra evolution with full T_tilde return. Derive from actual generators, not merely a kernel-error insertion without stability control.
definitions.controls: Discriminate omission of repeated memory return, scalar/two-channel closure, wrong Schur/Volterra sign, inconsistent energy/time scaling, lambda0. Noncommuting finite matrices test identities only; no finite fixture proves complete graph dynamics.
definitions.error: Seek a quantified weak-coupling error at each fixed sigma using complementary leakage and projected Duhamel or an independently justified Volterra stability bound. State growing-time regimes actually proved, absolute versus relative error, and whether any uniform-time claim has additional proof.
definitions.exceptions: lambda0 exact electric reduction; common scalar energy shift must move every diagonal and time factor consistently. Failed proposed upper bound is not actual nonconvergence. Constant and time-dependent lambda are different Hamiltonian problems.
definitions.inherited: 0<=Vmag<=40, ||B1||=5/2, B1*B1=M_k with4<=k<=25/4, C0>=3alpha, P reduces H_E. These are actual Q2 theorems, not finite matrix estimates.
definitions.novelty: Separate project error certificate and standard bounded-block identities. Primary-source attribution and reading depth; no priority claim.
definitions.scales: Fixed a,E_star,alpha/E_star,hbar>0; 0<=lambda<=1/100; physical heat time t>=0; sigma=alpha*t/hbar. No fitted time coefficient.

model: Exactly Q2 finite physical magnetic graph: 18 vertices,33 edges,20 faces, all Gauss constraints, full infinite-rank selected space from P2. No homogeneous/canonical transfer.
